note: Query wordings per family. {item} is the item's request_phrase; {company}, {name}, {role}, {date} and {ticket} are filled by scripts/dataset/build_tasks.py. Full dataset: 10 train and 5 eval wordings per family (encoding: 5 eval). Train-split companies use only the train pool; eval-split companies use only the eval pool (docs/07, Q45). Families with held_out=true never appear in training. Email and document families take their wordings from per-company carriers.
